description: Use this when the user wants pools across chains or DEXes with recent volume and a fee rate, such as "high fee pools on Base with real volume". All arguments are optional: chains, min_volume_usd_1d (default 50000), min_fee_percent (default 0.05), and limit (default 5, at most 8). Returns each pool's id, volume, TVL, fee rate, 1-day and 7-day fee APR, and an APR flag with its reason, highest 1-day fee APR first. A small pool with a one-day volume spike can rank first, so check tvl_usd and apr_flag before you lead with it, or raise min_volume_usd_1d. It does not read token contracts or the current tick. Call check_pool with a returned pool_id for token flags and the risk checklist.

chains.description: Optional chain names, such as ["base"] or ["ethereum", "arbitrum"]. Supported: ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc, avalanche, solana, zksync, linea, gnosis, scroll, mantle, celo, sonic, or sui. Omit to scan every chain in the index

limit.description: How many pools to return, at most 8. Default 5

min_fee_percent.description: Minimum swap fee in percent, not a fraction: 0.3 means 0.3%. Read from pool metadata. Default 0.05

min_volume_usd_1d.description: Minimum 1-day volume in USD. Default 50000. Raise it, for example to 1000000, to skip small pools with a one-day spike

name: find_active_pools

as_of.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of the yields index read, or null when nothing was read

pools.description: Pools ranked by 1-day fee APR, highest first. Check tvl_usd and apr_flag before leading with one

apr_flag.description: real: steady trading. spike: a short burst, not a steady rate. unconfirmed: no 7-day comparison, do not call it real

fee_rate.description: Swap fee as a fraction, not a percent: 0.003 means 0.3%. Read from pool_meta

pool_meta.description: DefiLlama pool label, often the fee tier such as "0.3%"

tvl_usd.description: Total value locked in the pool, in USD

fee_apr_percent_1d.description: Fee APR in percent from 1-day volume: volume x fee_rate x 365 / TVL x 100

fee_apr_percent_7d.description: Fee APR in percent from 7-day volume, annualized the same way

volume_usd_1d.description: Trading volume over the last day, in USD

volume_usd_7d.description: Trading volume over the last 7 days, in USD

as_of.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of the yields index read, or null when nothing was read

status.description: unavailable: the yields index could not be read; try again later

title: Find pools with volume and fees
